evals.prompt: Design a new v2 inbound phone agent that answers opening hours, returns policy, product FAQs and shipping questions from our help center. Only propose the architecture; do not call APIs.
evals.expected_output: Reference topics use knowledge sources and one shared Answer questions scenario with a knowledge step, not four mini-pathways. Explain that agent-wide knowledge alone requires verification on inbound calls.
assertions: Uses step kbIds for unverified inbound retrieval
Plans answerable and absent question checks with Query Logs/chunks

evals.prompt: Design a new v2 appointment agent: collect service and contact details, check live availability, confirm and book. Callers may ask pricing and cancellation-policy questions halfway through booking. Only propose the architecture; do not call APIs.
evals.expected_output: One continuous booking workflow owns live tools and confirmation. Reference content uses knowledge within the flow rather than separate pricing/cancellation scenarios. Verify Q&A followed by continuation without restarting booking.
assertions: Preserves ordered booking workflow and tool gates
No standalone scenario per reference topic
Plans a mid-task reference question and continuation check

evals.prompt: Design a new v2 support agent that answers published returns-policy questions and can return a caller's order: identify the order, check live eligibility, confirm, submit the return, or transfer to a person. Only propose the architecture; do not call APIs.
evals.expected_output: Policy facts use knowledge, while returning an order remains an ordered workflow with live lookups, a confirmed write and distinct outcomes. Do not replace operational steps with static knowledge answers.
assertions: Separates static policy from returning an order
Keeps live eligibility and confirmed submission as tools
